item.title: Taurus rising: meaning and what it says about you
item.description: Taurus rising means Taurus was the sign on the eastern horizon at the moment and place you were born. In astrology the rising sign stands for the first impression you give; Taurus is an earth sign ruled by Venus, steady and sensory. You bring calm into rooms just by standing in them. Read more at astralroots.app
